biological_reference.closest_mechanism: cortical / cortico-striatal disinhibition -- VIP-expressing interneurons inhibit SOM interneurons (inhibition-on-inhibition), acting as a TOP-DOWN CONTEXT channel that reconfigures competition when contexts differ (VIP fires when center != surround; Keller et al Neuron 2020, necessary+sufficient by optogenetics). In biologically-constrained switching RNNs + causal mouse V1 silencing (Rungratsameetaweemana/Aquino PLOS Biology 2026), weakening the inhibition-to-inhibition motif specifically COLLAPSES task-SWITCHING while other connection types leave processing intact -- i.e. the disinhibitory channel's functional role is BETWEEN-context reconfiguration, and it operates by modulating RECURRENT excitation.
dependencies: a differentiated context / segregated parallel loops to switch/reconfigure BETWEEN (the biology requires center!=surround, i.e. differentiated value structure across the competing units)
recurrent excitatory structure the disinhibition modulates (not a flat argmin field)
a competition that is not already monopolized by one dominant score

The biological disinhibition reconfigures competition ACROSS differentiated loops; over an F-collapsed single field the same graded lateral inhibition sharpens toward the F-winner (observed: -0.169 and -0.153 nat committed-class-entropy REDUCTION on divergent seeds 44/46; only seed 42 lifted +0.071). This is a missing-dependency / wrong-locus signature -- a discovered prerequisite (segregated loops with differentiated value), not a falsification of the disinhibition primitive.

Headline all-seed means can invert the per-divergent-seed decision statistic: 710's INTACT>OFF on the all-6-seed mean (+0.021) is driven entirely by non-divergent seeds (collapsed proposer, nothing to convert); on divergent seeds INTACT<OFF. Always read the conversion DV on divergent seeds only.
